summary: PagSeguro Digital Ltd. filed a Form 6-K containing unaudited condensed consolidated interim financial statements for the quarter ended March 31, 2026. The filing is a routine periodic report of a foreign private issuer, equivalent to an interim financial update. No terms regarding price per share, premium, or deal mechanics are applicable. There is no board recommendation, advisor, or strategic action disclosed. The filing solely presents financial position and performance metrics in Brazilian reais; no special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring is noted. This is a standard earnings release with no actionable corporate event.
